The parser crashes on an empty line at the end of the file.
  ▸ 958891a3 turn ·118t
The crash comes from split_lines in reader.py.
It drops the last line when the file ends with an empty line.
The parser then reads one line past the end of the list and raises IndexError.
The fix keeps a trailing newline as its own empty line, so the line count matches the file.
I added two tests: a file that ends with one newline, and a file that ends with two newlines.
Both pass on CPython and GraalPy; the change is four lines in reader.py.

  ▸ 73f093c8 turn ·30t

Oil the derailleur pivots once a month; keep oil off the derailleur pulleys.

My bike chain skips on the small cog when I climb.
  ▸ 21a96e2f turn ·31t
A worn chain skips under load. Measure the stretch with a chain gauge; replace it at 0.75 percent.
  ▸ e5cf143a turn ·18t
The new chain still skips on the smallest cog.
  ▸ 2922307c turn ·18t
Then the cog is worn too. Replace the cassette.
  ▸ 8ea70725 turn ·14t
Should I adjust the derailleur?
  ▸ 817b763f turn ·35t
Only if the chain skips on every cog: then the derailleur needs a tune. Turn the derailleur barrel a quarter turn.

The kettle boils too fast and my green tea turns bitter.
  ▸ d98e0bf6 turn ·31t

  ▸ 3eddf45e turn ·15t
Can I steep the same leaves twice?
  ▸ cc1a25aa turn ·20t
Yes. The second steep needs about thirty seconds more.
  ▸ 69a7a766 turn ·11t

  ▸ d73b0b0e turn ·24t
Oolong takes hotter water, about 90 C. Steep oolong for three minutes.
